# Repo-owned libdwarf-lite source snapshot

This is the unmodified commit archive of [jeremy-rifkin/libdwarf-lite](https://github.com/jeremy-rifkin/libdwarf-lite) at `5dfb2cd2aacf2bf473e5bfea79e41289f88b3a5f`, the exact pin used by cpptrace's Mac symbol backend. It was retrieved on 2026-11-07 from GitHub's commit archive; the archive SHA-256 is `ba0f0325e671e5010acbff4a897cedfe29c7f71202a905ca4b10085cbb839e51`. All 132 regular archive files matched the extracted bytes. This note is Enroth Continuum metadata.

The original `COPYING` and `src/lib/libdwarf/LGPL.txt` plus source copyright files are retained. The library source is LGPL-2.1; the top-level notice also describes other component terms. This snapshot alone does not select cpptrace's local source path or settle static-link distribution obligations. It contains no Might & Magic data.
